what: An INDEPENDENT cross-check of src/data/census-2011.json, captured once and committed so npm test stays offline.
why: src/data/census-2011.json is parsed from Wikipedia, which is a SECONDARY source. One source is not evidence.
These figures come from a different publisher of the same census, so agreement is meaningful and divergence is informative.

The two publishers use different BOUNDARY VINTAGES. Ours apportions the 2011 count to current district borders; this source reports the district as it existed in 2011. Where a district has not been split since 2011 the two agree to within 0.15%. Where it has, they differ by construction, and the district is listed under splitSince2011 with the parent figure so the gap is documented rather than discovered.

DST-22-RAIPUR.note: Baloda Bazar, Gariaband and Mahasamund territory separated after 2011

DST-22-BILASPUR.note: Mungeli and later Gaurela-Pendra-Marwahi separated after 2011

DST-22-BASTAR.note: Sukma, Kondagaon and Narayanpur separated from undivided Bastar
